anima.maneuvers.derribo.name: Trip
anima.maneuvers.derribo.description: -30 attack penalty (-60 with small weapon) vs Armor Type 0. If damage ≥ 10% → opposed STR/DEX vs STR/AGI check. Quadruped defender: +3.
anima.maneuvers.desarme.name: Disarm
anima.maneuvers.desarme.description: -40 attack penalty vs Armor Type 0. If damage ≥ 10% → opposed STR/DEX vs STR/DEX check. Deals no damage.
anima.maneuvers.presa.name: Grapple
anima.maneuvers.presa.description: -40 attack penalty vs Armor Type 0. Only with unarmed or grapple-capable weapons. If damage ≥ 10% → opposed STR/DEX vs STR/AGI check. Difference <3: Minor Paralysis; ≥3: Partial Paralysis; >10: Complete Paralysis.

anima.maneuvers.engatillar.name: Threaten
anima.maneuvers.engatillar.description: -100 attack, armor applies. No damage. Defender becomes Threatened. No opposed check.
anima.maneuvers.charging.name: Charge
anima.maneuvers.charging.description: Status: +10 Attack, -10 Block, -20 Dodge. Declare before initiative. Press Execute to toggle the Charging state.
anima.maneuvers.mounted.name: Mounted
anima.maneuvers.mounted.description: Status: if Ride<0 apply -20 to attack and block; if Ride>40 apply +20 to attack (high ground); always caps dodge at the Ride value. Declare when mounting. Press Execute to toggle.
anima.maneuvers.crush.name: Crush
anima.maneuvers.crush.description: Sub-grapple. Only if the attacker grappled unarmed and the defender is in Total or Complete Paralysis. No attack roll: STR vs STR (defender adds +1 per point of impact armor). Auto damage: 10 per point of difference, 20 per point if diff>6.
anima.maneuvers.inutilizar.name: Disable
anima.maneuvers.inutilizar.description: Aimed at arm or leg (-20). Damage/2, crit uses full damage. Limb counts as weak point.
anima.maneuvers.inconsciencia.name: Knock unconscious
anima.maneuvers.inconsciencia.descriptio: Aimed at head (-60) with bludgeoning weapon. If crit >50, defender unconscious. Non-bludgeoning: -40 extra.
anima.maneuvers.dano-retrasado.name: Delayed damage
anima.maneuvers.dano-retrasado.descripti: Master maneuver. Declare 1-5 rounds before rolling; -10 to attack (cut/thrust/impact). Damage is not applied on hit but those rounds later, and always causes bleeding when it manifests. Requires attack Mastery (base >= 200).
anima.maneuvers.lluvia-de-proyectiles.de: Master maneuver. Ranged area attack: doubles the weapon's Base Damage. Radius = 1 m per 20 Attack Ability (Rate of Fire ≤50) or per 40 (RoF >50). No penalty, except -50 when choosing targets within the area. Full attack action; requires ≥5 projectiles/round. Requires attack Mastery (base >= 200).
anima.maneuvers.ataque-ropa.name: Aimed attack: Clothing
anima.maneuvers.ataque-ropa.description: Master. Cuts or tears a foe's clothing without harming their body. -150 attack penalty, or -100 if the selected weapon has the Precise quality. Deals no body damage by default (you may tick 'Cause damage' if desired). The Breakage/Sturdiness check vs armor and combining with other maneuvers (e.g. Area) are handled manually. Requires Mastery in Attack (base >= 200).
anima.maneuvers.disparo-rebote.name: Aimed shot: Ricochet
anima.maneuvers.disparo-rebote.descripti: Master. Bounces projectiles off the environment to hit targets out of the line of fire. Penalty to choose: -20 (one bounce) or -40 (multiple). Base Damage is reduced by 10. Partial (-40) or full (-80) Blindness when attacking a covered enemy is added manually via the dialog modifier. Requires Mastery in Attack (base >= 200).
anima.maneuvers.inmovilizar-distancia.de: Master. Immobilizes a foe with projectiles (pinning their clothes to a wall, no damage, or piercing limbs). Presa-style opposed check but with a FIXED characteristic of 8 for the attacker (±3 at GM discretion via the check's 'Extra modifier'). Choose -80 (no damage) or -50 (with damage). Full attack action. The target must be next to a wall. Requires Mastery in Attack (base >= 200).
